name: Progress-37
about: Progress-37 (1988-061A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1988 Jul 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 Jul 25), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
